about: Every wizard and multi-step flow in the browser, and the keyboard tasks that cover it (tools/a11y/tasks.mjs and wizards.mjs). tools/check-wizard-coverage.py fails when a flow here has no task, a task id is not in those files, a script that draws a wizard is in no flow, or a file named here is missing. A flow in the terminal (browser false) names the tests that cover it instead. Add the flow here when you add a wizard.
